title: Libre Del Cigarrillo: Development of an mHealth Smoking Cessation App to Extend Reach of a Validated Smoking Cessation Intervention for Spanish-speaking Smokers
official: Libre Del Cigarrillo: Development of an mHealth Smoking Cessation App to Extend Reach of a Validated Smoking Cessation Intervention for Spanish-speaking Smokers
summary: Pilot randomized controlled trial evaluating feasibility, acceptability, and trial-readiness of the new app compared with the existing print booklets and the NCI SmokefreeTXT en Español program.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Self-identify as Hispanic/Latinx.
* 18+ Years of age.
* Monolingual Spanish-speaking, or bilingual Spanish-English and prefer educational health materials in Spanish.
* Have been smoking at least 5 cigarettes per week over the past year
* Not currently enrolled in a face-to-face or virtual smoking cessation program.

Exclusion Criteria:

* A household member enrolled in the study.
* Prior participation in the LDC randomized controlled trial.
* Prior use of the NCI SmokefreeTXT program.
sponsor: H. Lee Moffitt Cancer Center and Research Institute
